name: Items
_about: Field added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (03 Fulfillment / 05 Crate and Dispatch, CR-R1): the catalog had no way to flag an item as fragile. QC routing ORs this flag with the QC record's own For_Crate checkbox, so a fragile item is routed to Crate automatically even when nobody ticked For_Crate by hand.

fields.name: Fragile
fields.label: Fragile
fields.helpText: CR-R1: items flagged fragile are routed to Crate at QC approval, even if For_Crate was left unchecked.
